summary.title: SecureNova AI Customer Service Platform - Identity Threat Model
summary.description: STRIDE-per-flow threat model of the SecureNova LLM agent platform (Auth0 IdP, AI chatbot harness, internal REST APIs, RAG pipeline, MCP server, external LLM provider). 14 identity flows x 6 STRIDE categories = 84 assessments (81 threats, 3 justified N/A). Companion matrix: 01-threat-model/STRIDE-Matrix.md.

diagrams.title: SecureNova AI Platform - Identity Data Flow (STRIDE)
diagrams.description: DFD with eight trust boundaries: User/Frontend, Identity Provider, Application Backend, Agent Runtime, Internal API, RAG Pipeline, MCP Server, External Provider.

data.name: TB1 User / Frontend Boundary
data.description: Untrusted client device and user input.

data.name: TB2 Identity Provider Boundary
data.description: Third-party SaaS (Auth0) that issues all tokens.

data.name: TB3 Application Backend Boundary
data.description: SecureNova-controlled server zone (contains the Agent Runtime boundary).

data.name: TB4 Agent Runtime Trust Boundary
data.description: Non-deterministic LLM-driven code holding workload credentials.

data.name: TB5 Internal API Trust Boundary
data.description: Systems of record requiring scoped access tokens.

data.name: TB6 RAG Pipeline Trust Boundary
data.description: Stores and serves untrusted ingested content.

data.name: TB7 MCP Server Trust Boundary
data.description: Tool-execution identity acting on internal APIs.

data.name: TB8 External Provider Boundary
data.description: Third-party LLM API reached with the LLM API key.

data.name: User
data.description: Human customer or admin. Identity: Auth0 user (password + TOTP MFA). Privilege: read:ai-data (user) or write:admin (admin role).

data.name: User Interface
data.description: Browser chat UI (Regular Web App client).

data.name: Auth0 Tenant
data.description: Identity provider: OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE for users, Client Credentials for M2M clients, RS256-signed tokens.

data.name: Chatbot Backend Endpoint
data.description: Confidential OIDC client / BFF. Validates tokens, holds user session, enforces RBAC.

data.name: AI Chatbot Harness
data.description: LLM agent. Identities: agent_id, OAuth M2M client (client credentials), LLM API key holder.

data.name: Secrets Manager
data.description: Holds M2M client credential and LLM API key.

data.name: Chat Session DB
data.description: Sessions and chat transcripts (may contain PII).

data.name: LLM Provider
data.description: External model API authenticated with a static LLM API key.

data.name: Internal REST APIs
data.description: Resource server. Scopes: read:ai-data (user), write:admin (admin).

data.name: RAG Service
data.description: Retrieval service. Identity: RAG pipeline service identity (read on vector store).

data.name: Vector Store
data.description: Embedded knowledge-base chunks with provenance metadata.

data.name: Embedding Service
data.description: Stateless text-to-vector transform.

data.name: MCP Server
data.description: Tool server. Identity: MCP server identity (dedicated M2M client).

data.name: F01 User interaction
data.description: Human user enters prompts and login credentials in the browser. Inside TB1.

threats.title: T-F01-S Phishing / look-alike UI
threats.description: Phishing or look-alike chat UI harvests user password and TOTP; attacker then logs in as the user.
threats.mitigation: Credentials only on Auth0 Universal Login; TOTP MFA; brute-force protection; Suspicious IP Throttling; custom domain; awareness.

threats.title: T-F01-T XSS / extension alters input
threats.description: XSS or malicious browser extension modifies chat input or submits injected prompts in the user's name.
threats.mitigation: Strict CSP (no inline script), SRI, output encoding, Trusted Types.

threats.title: T-F01-R User denies prompt
threats.description: User denies typing a harmful prompt that triggered an agent action.
threats.mitigation: Server-side attribution on F04 (sub, session id, prompt hash, timestamp).

threats.title: T-F01-I Tokens in browser storage
threats.description: Tokens in localStorage or chat content on shared device readable by XSS or next user.
threats.mitigation: BFF pattern - tokens server-side, HttpOnly cookies, idle auto-logout, no sensitive browser storage.

threats.title: T-F01-D N/A
threats.description: N/A - interaction is local to the user's own device; no shared resource is consumed. Service-level DoS is assessed on F02 and F04.

threats.title: T-F01-E N/A
threats.description: N/A - no privilege boundary is crossed; the user acts with their own rights. Escalation is assessed on F04, F05 and F08.

labels: F02 OIDC authorize with PKCE / code callback

data.name: F02 OIDC authorize with PKCE / code callback
data.description: Browser redirect to Auth0 /authorize (code_challenge S256, state, nonce) and callback with code. Crosses TB1 -> TB2.

threats.title: T-F02-S Login CSRF / callback injection
threats.description: Attacker injects their authorization code into the victim browser, or an open redirect delivers the code to an attacker URL.
threats.mitigation: Exact-match Allowed Callback URLs; state and nonce validation; HTTPS only; no wildcard redirect URIs.

threats.title: T-F02-T PKCE downgrade / scope tampering
threats.description: Authorize request tampered: code_challenge stripped, redirect_uri altered, or write:admin added to scope.
threats.mitigation: Require PKCE S256; scopes granted by Auth0 RBAC not client request; write:admin only for admin role.

threats.title: T-F02-R Disputed login/MFA
threats.description: User disputes a login or MFA event.
threats.mitigation: Stream Auth0 tenant logs (login success/fail, MFA enrol/challenge) to SIEM with retention.

threats.title: T-F02-I Authorization code leakage
threats.description: Authorization code leaks via Referer, browser history or proxy logs.
threats.mitigation: Single-use short-lived codes; PKCE renders leaked code useless; Referrer-Policy no-referrer; response_mode=form_post.

threats.title: T-F02-D Credential stuffing lockout
threats.description: Credential stuffing or login floods lock out legitimate users and exhaust Auth0 rate limits.
threats.mitigation: Brute-force protection (10 attempts, 15 min block); Suspicious IP Throttling; Bot Detection.

threats.title: T-F02-E MFA bypass / role escalation at signup
threats.description: MFA bypass, or self-signup / account linking path yields elevated roles.
threats.mitigation: MFA enforced for all users; disable public signup or default user role; admin roles assigned only by tenant admins.

labels: F03 Authorization code, verifier; ID/access tokens

data.name: F03 Authorization code, verifier; ID/access tokens
data.description: Back-channel /oauth/token exchange (code + code_verifier + client auth) returning RS256 ID and access tokens. Crosses TB2 -> TB3.

threats.title: T-F03-S Forged or wrong-audience token
threats.description: Backend accepts forged token (alg=none, HS/RS key confusion) or one issued for another tenant/audience.
threats.mitigation: Verify RS256 via Auth0 JWKS; pin algorithm; validate iss, aud, exp, nbf and ID-token nonce.

threats.title: T-F03-T JWT claim tampering
threats.description: JWT claims (scope, agent_id, roles) modified to gain access.
threats.mitigation: Use claims only after signature verification; reject unsigned tokens and unknown kid.

threats.title: T-F03-R Token issuance not provable
threats.description: Cannot prove which token was issued to which session or client.
threats.mitigation: Correlate Auth0 code-exchange logs with backend logs by sub, client_id, jti and session id.

threats.title: T-F03-I Client secret / token in logs
threats.description: Client secret or tokens written to application logs; ID token over-shares PII.
threats.mitigation: Client secret in Secrets Manager; scrub Authorization headers and tokens from logs; minimal claims; TLS 1.2+.

threats.title: T-F03-D IdP / JWKS unavailability
threats.description: Auth0 outage, rate limiting or JWKS fetch failure blocks all logins and token validation.
threats.mitigation: JWKS caching with refresh-on-unknown-kid; retries with backoff; fail closed with clear error.

threats.title: T-F03-E ID token used as access token / long TTL
threats.description: ID token accepted as an API access token, or long-lived tokens extend attack window.
threats.mitigation: APIs accept only access tokens with correct aud; access-token TTL 300 s; refresh token rotation with reuse detection.

labels: F04 Chat request: session cookie; response

data.name: F04 Chat request: session cookie; response
data.description: Authenticated chat request from browser to backend. Crosses TB1 -> TB3 (user layer to application/agent layer).

threats.title: T-F04-S Session hijack / CSRF
threats.description: Stolen session cookie replayed, or CSRF sends chat requests as the victim.
threats.mitigation: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies; anti-CSRF token; session rotation on login; short idle/absolute timeouts.

threats.title: T-F04-T Identity field / direct prompt injection
threats.description: Client injects role/user_id fields in the body or direct prompt-injection content.
threats.mitigation: Derive identity only from server session; ignore client identity fields; schema validation; input guardrails.

threats.title: T-F04-R User denies prompt
threats.description: User denies sending the prompt that led to an agent action.
threats.mitigation: Tamper-evident audit log of sub, session id, request id, prompt hash and timestamp.

threats.title: T-F04-I IDOR / secret leakage in responses
threats.description: IDOR on conversation id exposes another user's chat; verbose errors or model output leak secrets.
threats.mitigation: Conversation ownership check; generic errors; output guardrail redacting JWT-shaped strings.

threats.title: T-F04-D Prompt flooding / denial of wallet
threats.description: Prompt flooding or oversized prompts exhaust LLM budget.
threats.mitigation: Per-user rate limits; max input tokens; WAF; request body size limits.

threats.title: T-F04-E User reaches admin function
threats.description: User-level session reaches admin functions via hidden endpoints or by asking the agent to act as admin.
threats.mitigation: Server-side RBAC (read:ai-data vs write:admin, 403 on mismatch); agent never exceeds calling user's privilege.

labels: F05 Request + validated user context / response

data.name: F05 Request + validated user context / response
data.description: Backend forwards prompt plus verified user context (sub, roles) to the agent harness. Crosses TB3 -> TB4.

threats.title: T-F05-S Direct call with forged user context
threats.description: Attacker bypasses backend and calls the harness directly with a forged user context.
threats.mitigation: Network policy (backend-only ingress); mTLS or Ed25519-signed context envelope verified by harness.

threats.title: T-F05-T User context / system prompt override
threats.description: User context altered in transit, or user text mixed into the prompt overrides system instructions.
threats.mitigation: Signed structured context separate from prompt; immutable system prompt; input guardrails.

threats.title: T-F05-R Agent action not linked to user
threats.description: Agent actions cannot be traced back to the originating user (confused-deputy audit gap).
threats.mitigation: Propagate request id, user sub and agent_id to every downstream call and log at each hop.

threats.title: T-F05-I System prompt extraction (LLM07)
threats.description: System prompt or embedded credentials extracted and returned to the user.
threats.mitigation: No secrets in system prompt; output guardrail; canary strings to detect leakage.

threats.title: T-F05-D Agent loop exhaustion
threats.description: Recursive reasoning or tool-call loops consume compute and tokens.
threats.mitigation: Max agent steps; per-request timeout; per-conversation token budget.

threats.title: T-F05-E Confused deputy via agent privileges
threats.description: Agent acts with its own M2M privileges instead of the user's, giving users indirect access.
threats.mitigation: Authorize against intersection of user and agent scope; token exchange / on-behalf-of with act claim.

data.name: F06 Read/write session data
data.description: Backend reads and writes sessions and chat history using its DB service identity. Inside TB3.

threats.title: T-F06-S Shared DB credentials
threats.description: Another service connects with shared DB credentials, impersonating the backend.
threats.mitigation: Per-service DB identity (IAM auth); network ACLs; no shared DB accounts.

threats.title: T-F06-T Chat memory poisoning
threats.description: Stored chat history modified to plant persistent prompt injection.
threats.mitigation: Backend-only write; parameterized queries; treat history as untrusted on re-prompt; record integrity hash.

threats.title: T-F06-R Untraced history changes
threats.description: Deletion or modification of chat history without trace.
threats.mitigation: DB audit logging; append-only audit table.

threats.title: T-F06-I Transcript / PII exposure
threats.description: Transcripts containing PII or tokens exposed via DB breach or backups.
threats.mitigation: Encryption at rest; redact tokens before persistence; retention limits; per-user row-level access.

threats.title: T-F06-D Storage exhaustion
threats.description: Very large transcripts or abusive volume exhaust storage.
threats.mitigation: Message size caps; per-user quotas; retention purge jobs.

threats.title: T-F06-E SQL injection to DB admin
threats.description: SQL injection through chat content yields DB admin rights.
threats.mitigation: Parameterized queries; least-privilege DB role (DML only, no DDL).

labels: F07 M2M credential + LLM API key

data.name: F07 M2M credential + LLM API key
data.description: Harness retrieves its M2M client credential and LLM API key from Secrets Manager. Crosses TB3 -> TB4.

threats.title: T-F07-S Workload impersonation to read secrets
threats.description: Another workload impersonates the harness to read its secrets.
threats.mitigation: Workload identity (cloud IAM role / SPIFFE); per-secret access policy bound to harness identity only.

threats.title: T-F07-T Secret value substitution
threats.description: Secret replaced with attacker-controlled value (e.g. routes LLM traffic to attacker account).
threats.mitigation: Restricted write access; secret versioning; alert on every secret change.

threats.title: T-F07-R Secret access not logged
threats.description: No record of who read or rotated a secret.
threats.mitigation: Secrets Manager access logs forwarded to SIEM.

threats.title: T-F07-I LLM API key exfiltration via prompt injection
threats.description: LLM API key or M2M secret loaded into env vars or prompt context and exfiltrated via prompt injection (Attack Tree 1).
threats.mitigation: Never place secrets in model context (HTTP client only); short-lived M2M tokens; rotation at most 90 days; output redaction.

threats.title: T-F07-D Secrets Manager unavailable
threats.description: Secrets Manager unavailable, so the agent cannot authenticate.
threats.mitigation: In-memory cache with TTL; HA secrets service; alerting.

threats.title: T-F07-E Wildcard secret read
threats.description: Harness has wildcard read on all secrets; one compromise exposes every credential.
threats.mitigation: Least-privilege policy per secret path; quarterly access review.

labels: F08 M2M token + least-privilege scope / API response

data.name: F08 M2M token + least-privilege scope / API response
data.description: Agent calls internal APIs with an Auth0 client-credentials access token. Crosses TB4 -> TB5 (agent layer to internal API layer).

threats.title: T-F08-S Stolen M2M token / agent spoofing
threats.description: Stolen M2M token or client secret used to impersonate the agent (Attack Tree 2).
threats.mitigation: TTL 60-300 s; private_key_jwt or mTLS sender-constrained tokens; source IP allow-list; alert on token reuse after expiry.

threats.title: T-F08-T Injected agent alters API parameters
threats.description: Prompt-injected agent tampers with API parameters (e.g. customer id, amount).
threats.mitigation: Server-side per-object authorization against propagated user context; strict parameter validation.

threats.title: T-F08-R Agent-on-behalf-of not attributable
threats.description: API cannot distinguish agent acting for user A vs user B.
threats.mitigation: Log client_id, agent_id, user sub (act claim), scope and request id on every call.

threats.title: T-F08-I Excessive API data into LLM
threats.description: API returns more data than needed, which then flows into the LLM.
threats.mitigation: Field-level filtering; data minimization; scope-based response shaping.

threats.title: T-F08-D Agent call volume spike
threats.description: Agent call volume spike overwhelms internal APIs.
threats.mitigation: Per-client rate limits; alert on more than 20 requests in 60 s.

threats.title: T-F08-E Over-scoped M2M client / scope change
threats.description: Agent M2M client granted write:admin, or scope changes between consecutive requests.
threats.mitigation: M2M grant limited to required scopes; API enforces scope; alert on scope change.

labels: F09 Prompt over TLS + key in auth header / model response

data.name: F09 Prompt over TLS + key in auth header / model response
data.description: Harness sends prompts to the external LLM authenticated with the LLM API key. Crosses TB4 -> TB8.

threats.title: T-F09-S Fake LLM endpoint / stolen key
threats.description: DNS/proxy misconfiguration routes prompts to a fake endpoint, or a stolen key impersonates SecureNova to the provider.
threats.mitigation: TLS certificate validation; fixed provider hostname; egress allow-list; provider-side key restrictions.

threats.title: T-F09-T Response tampering in transit
threats.description: Man-in-the-middle alters model responses.
threats.mitigation: TLS 1.2+; treat model output as untrusted; validate proposed tool calls.

threats.title: T-F09-R LLM usage not attributable
threats.description: Cannot attribute LLM usage or cost to a user or agent.
threats.mitigation: Per-environment keys; request id and user tag in provider metadata; usage logs to SIEM.

threats.title: T-F09-I Sensitive data to third-party LLM
threats.description: Prompts carry PII, tokens or system prompt to a third party that may retain them.
threats.mitigation: Pre-send redaction and data minimization; zero-retention / DPA with provider.

threats.title: T-F09-D Quota exhaustion / denial of wallet
threats.description: Provider rate-limit or quota exhaustion through abuse.
threats.mitigation: Spend budgets and quotas; circuit breaker; fallback model.

threats.title: T-F09-E Excessive agency from model output
threats.description: Model output instructs the harness to call privileged tools or APIs (LLM06).
threats.mitigation: Per-role tool allow-list; policy engine outside the LLM; human approval for privileged actions.

labels: F10 Query with agent identity / retrieved text

data.name: F10 Query with agent identity / retrieved text
data.description: Agent queries the RAG service and receives retrieved chunks. Crosses TB4 -> TB6.

threats.title: T-F10-S Unauthenticated / spoofed RAG query
threats.description: Unauthenticated caller queries RAG directly, or harness claims another user's identity to obtain their documents.
threats.mitigation: RAG requires agent workload token; per-user ACL filters derived only from verified context.

threats.title: T-F10-T Retrieval steering / chunk alteration
threats.description: Queries crafted to retrieve poisoned chunks, or retrieved text altered in transit.
threats.mitigation: TLS; provenance-tagged, hash-verified chunks; content sanitization.

threats.title: T-F10-R Chunk influence not recorded
threats.description: No record of which chunks influenced an answer or action.
threats.mitigation: Log chunk id, source document and version per request.

threats.title: T-F10-I Cross-user document leakage
threats.description: Cross-user or cross-tenant document leakage via semantic search.
threats.mitigation: Document-level ACL enforced at retrieval via metadata filters, never only in the prompt.

threats.title: T-F10-D Expensive retrieval queries
threats.description: Expensive queries (large top-k, long text) degrade the service.
threats.mitigation: Cap top-k and query length; timeouts; rate limits.

threats.title: T-F10-E Indirect prompt injection via retrieved chunk
threats.description: Retrieved chunk carries instructions the agent follows to escalate actions (Attack Tree 3).
threats.mitigation: Treat chunks as data (spotlighting/delimiters); guardrails on retrieved text; privileged actions require authorization outside the LLM.

data.name: F11 Embedding request / response
data.description: RAG service sends text to the embedding service and receives vectors. Inside TB6.

threats.title: T-F11-S Rogue embedding endpoint
threats.description: A rogue embedding endpoint is substituted.
threats.mitigation: Fixed endpoint configuration; mTLS or API-key service auth.

threats.title: T-F11-T Embedding manipulation
threats.description: Embedding vectors or model version manipulated to steer retrieval.
threats.mitigation: Pinned model version; integrity-checked deployment; TLS.

threats.title: T-F11-R Embedding version untracked
threats.description: Cannot determine which embedding model version indexed a chunk.
threats.mitigation: Record embedding model id and version with every indexed chunk.

threats.title: T-F11-I Document text to third-party embedder
threats.description: Document text sent to a third-party embedding API.
threats.mitigation: Self-hosted or approved provider; redact sensitive fields before embedding.

threats.title: T-F11-D Embedding service outage
threats.description: Embedding service outage blocks retrieval and ingestion.
threats.mitigation: Retries; query-embedding cache; ingestion queue.

threats.title: T-F11-E N/A
threats.description: N/A - the embedding service is a stateless transform that only returns vectors; it makes no authorization decisions and exposes no privileged operations.

data.name: F12 Scoped search / retrieved chunks
data.description: RAG service runs ACL-scoped similarity search against the vector store. Inside TB6.

threats.title: T-F12-S Unauthorized chunk writer
threats.description: Unauthorized writer impersonates the ingestion pipeline to insert chunks.
threats.mitigation: Separate read (query) and write (ingestion) identities; authentication enforced on vector DB.

threats.title: T-F12-T RAG chunk poisoning
threats.description: Malicious instructions inserted or modified in the store (Attack Tree 3).
threats.mitigation: Ingestion review and content scanning; signed chunk hashes verified at retrieval; provenance metadata.

threats.title: T-F12-R Chunk authorship unknown
threats.description: Cannot determine who inserted or changed a chunk.
threats.mitigation: Store author, source and ingest time per chunk; audit logs on writes.

threats.title: T-F12-I Vector store exposure / inversion
threats.description: Vector store exposed, or embeddings inverted to reconstruct source text.
threats.mitigation: Private network; authentication; encryption at rest.

threats.title: T-F12-D Index deletion / corruption
threats.description: Index deletion or corruption.
threats.mitigation: Snapshots and backups; restricted delete rights; tested restore.

threats.title: T-F12-E Query identity has write/admin rights
threats.description: RAG query identity holds write or admin rights on the store.
threats.mitigation: Read-only role for the query path; write only for ingestion identity.

labels: F13 Tool request with agent identity / result

data.name: F13 Tool request with agent identity / result
data.description: Agent invokes MCP tools, authenticating with its agent identity. Crosses TB4 -> TB7.

threats.title: T-F13-S Rogue MCP server / tool shadowing
threats.description: Rogue or look-alike MCP server/tool registered, or a caller impersonates the agent to MCP.
threats.mitigation: MCP server allow-list with pinned identity (mTLS/OAuth); agent authenticates with signed audience-bound token.

threats.title: T-F13-T Tool manifest / argument tampering
threats.description: Tool description poisoning, or tool arguments altered by injected content.
threats.mitigation: Pin and hash tool manifests; JSON-schema argument validation; Ed25519-signed agent messages.

threats.title: T-F13-R Tool invocation not attributable
threats.description: Tool invocation cannot be attributed to an agent or user.
threats.mitigation: Log tool name, argument hash, agent_id, user sub, request id and result.

threats.title: T-F13-I Secrets in tool results / logs
threats.description: Tool results containing secrets flow back into LLM context, or MCP server logs tokens.
threats.mitigation: Tool result filtering and redaction; no token passthrough.

threats.title: T-F13-D Hanging tools
threats.description: Long-running or hanging tools block the agent.
threats.mitigation: Per-tool timeouts; concurrency caps.

threats.title: T-F13-E Poisoned chunk triggers privileged tool
threats.description: Poisoned RAG chunk triggers a privileged MCP tool (e.g. refund, delete).
threats.mitigation: Per-tool scopes; deny by default; human-in-the-loop approval for destructive tools.

labels: F14 Tool call with MCP identity / tool result

data.name: F14 Tool call with MCP identity / tool result
data.description: MCP server calls internal APIs with its own M2M identity. Crosses TB7 -> TB5.

threats.title: T-F14-S Static MCP credential theft
threats.description: MCP server uses shared or static credentials; stolen credentials impersonate MCP.
threats.mitigation: Dedicated M2M client for MCP; short-TTL sender-constrained tokens.

threats.title: T-F14-T MCP rewrites requests
threats.description: MCP rewrites requests beyond what the agent asked.
threats.mitigation: API validates against propagated user/agent context; signed requests.

threats.title: T-F14-R Actor chain lost at API
threats.description: API logs show only MCP identity; the user-agent-tool chain is lost.
threats.mitigation: Propagate actor chain (RFC 8693 act claim) and request id; log at the API.

threats.title: T-F14-I Excess data to MCP
threats.description: API returns more data than the MCP tool needs.
threats.mitigation: Data minimization; scope-limited fields.

threats.title: T-F14-D Tool call storm
threats.description: Tool-call storm overloads internal APIs.
threats.mitigation: Per-MCP-client rate limits; circuit breaker.

threats.title: T-F14-E Token passthrough / confused deputy
threats.description: MCP forwards the agent's token or uses its own broader rights to act beyond the caller's privilege.
threats.mitigation: No token passthrough; MCP obtains audience-specific token via token exchange with scopes no wider than the caller.
